DANIEL OKAFOR-REYES
Backend Engineer | Java and Kotlin
[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [GITHUB URL]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with experience building Java and Kotlin services, REST APIs, and event-driven systems. Experienced with PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes on AWS EKS, automated testing, and production on-call. Python experience is limited to scripts; currently developing a Go CLI as a learning project.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Backend: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, REST APIs, OpenAPI 3
Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS
Cloud and containers: Kubernetes (EKS), AWS S3, Docker
Testing and delivery: Testcontainers, Spring Cloud Contract, Jenkins helper scripts
Additional: Python scripting; Go learning project

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Backend Engineer | Tejo Insurance Tech | 2022-Present
- Build and maintain Java and Kotlin Spring Boot microservices using Kafka and Kubernetes.
- Participate in the on-call rota; handled a Kafka lag incident in March 2024 and wrote a post-incident report that was praised.
- Run the backend guild meeting every two weeks, a responsibility held since 2024.

Software Developer | Viajar Online | 2019-2021
- Worked on booking and payments in a large Java application, including automated testing and service extraction.
- Increased payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70% using Testcontainers, enabling safer refactoring.

SELECTED PROJECTS
Partner Quoting API | Tejo Insurance Tech | 2022-2023
- Designed a versioned REST API using OpenAPI 3 for insurance brokers to request quotes.
- Added per-partner rate limiting and contract tests with Spring Cloud Contract; the API supported 12 broker partners and around 400,000 quote requests per month.
- Technologies: Java 17, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenAPI, Kubernetes (EKS).

Claims Outbox and Idempotent Consumers | Tejo Insurance Tech | 2023
- Implemented the transactional outbox pattern and consumer idempotency keys to address duplicate claim records caused by at-least-once Kafka delivery.
- Duplicate claims went from around 40 per week to zero over the following quarter.
- Technologies: Kafka, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL. Evaluated Debezium; it was not adopted.

Document Service in Kotlin | Tejo Insurance Tech | 2024
- Built a small internal Kotlin and Spring Boot service that renders policy PDFs from templates.
- Wrote the company's first Kotlin service guidelines.
- Technologies: AWS S3, AWS SQS.

Notifications Service Extraction | Viajar Online | 2021
- Extracted email and SMS notifications from the booking monolith into a separate Spring Boot service.
- Technologies: Java 11, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Thymeleaf, Oracle, Docker.

Go OpenAPI Diff CLI | Personal learning project
- Developing a CLI to diff OpenAPI specifications; approximately 600 lines of Go. Not a production project.

CERTIFICATION
Oracle Certified Professional Java SE 11 Developer | 2020

LANGUAGE
English: Worked fully in English at Tejo Insurance Tech.
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Backend Engineer (Python) role on Tessel Cargo Software's Routing & Tracking team. My production backend experience is in Java and Kotlin, and I am keen to move into Python-focused backend work. I have also used Python for scripts, including data fixes and small Jenkins helpers.

At Tejo Insurance Tech, I designed a versioned REST API for broker quote requests that now supports 12 partners and around 400,000 requests per month. I also addressed duplicate claim records caused by at-least-once Kafka delivery with a transactional outbox and idempotent consumers; duplicates fell from around 40 per week to zero over the following quarter. These projects have involved API design, PostgreSQL, event-driven services, and reliability in production.

I have also worked on automated testing and service extraction: at Viajar Online, I raised payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70% with Testcontainers and extracted notifications from a Java monolith into a Spring Boot service. In my current role, I participate in on-call and handled a Kafka lag incident in March 2024. The role's focus on event ingestion, Kafka streams, tracking API reliability, and production support is a strong match for this experience.

Tessel's work on dependable live shipment tracking and its focus on engineers owning and running their services particularly appeal to me. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend experience could contribute to the Routing & Tracking team.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
